_about: QA app modules: the trackers Hamida is standardising (Hall Close is the model). Each module can be switched on per home. Timings and owners come from the 25 Nov 2026 call with Hamida and Zara and Mark's emails of 24-25 Nov 2026. Everything here is INTERNAL ESTO CARE POLICY unless a module says otherwise, and every timing is UNVERIFIED until Hamida signs it off in docs/QA_APP.md.

modules.label: Finance
modules.summary: Residents' money: weekly checks by the team leader, a monthly roll-up by the deputy after four weeks, and a quarterly sign-off by the service manager.
modules.tracker: Finance Audit Tracker (Excel): Weekly Finance Audits, Monthly Roll-Up, Quarterly Governance, Finance Actions, Financial Variances
modules.basis_note: Internal Esto Care policy. Supports CQC Reg 13 (safeguarding from financial abuse) and Reg 17 (good governance). The MCA 2005 needs a capacity assessment, or a best-interest decision, before staff manage someone's money.

questions: All four weekly audits checked against evidence
Open finance actions reviewed and dated
MCA / best-interest / financial support plan in date for every resident whose money we handle

modules.label: Medication
modules.summary: Weekly medicines audit across eight areas, then a monthly audit by the deputy and a quarterly audit by the service manager.
modules.tracker: Medication Audits (Excel): Weekly Audits, Monthly Audits, Quarterly Audit, Actions
modules.basis_note: Recognised standard: NICE NG67 (managing medicines for adults receiving social care in the community) recommends regular medicines audits. Audit frequency is internal Esto Care policy. Supports CQC Reg 12.

questions: MAR / eMAR complete, no gaps or wrong codes
Controlled drugs: register and second signatures
PRN protocols in place and followed
Fridge/room temperatures recorded and in range
Recording of changes, allergies and leave
Staff competency in date for everyone giving medicines
Stock and ordering for next cycle
Trends in errors and incidents reviewed

modules.label: Health & Safety (IronOak)
modules.summary: Weekly landlord property check (IronOak) of 19 items across the communal areas and each room.
modules.tracker: IronOak 4-Week Health & Safety Tracker (Excel): one sheet per week plus Issues & Actions
modules.basis_note: Legal requirement for the landlord and responsible person to keep the property safe (Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005; Gas Safety Regs 1998; Housing Act 2004 HHSRS). The weekly checklist itself is the landlord's and Esto Care's policy. Zara prefers to chase this herself; included at ZACK's request, Mark to decide.

questions: Carbon monoxide alarm fitted and operational
All exit doors secure and locks operational
All windows secure and locks operational
External bin storage clean and tidy
Cooking equipment operational and fit for purpose
Electrical equipment operational and fit for purpose
PAT testing in date and visible
Gas safety certificate displayed and in date
Plumbing, toilets, sinks and showers clean and operational

modules.label: Fire & certificates
modules.summary: Fire log, drills, emergency lighting and the property certificates (gas, EICR, fire risk assessment and more), rated by the tested rules engine.
modules.basis_note: Each item shows its own basis (legal, guidance or policy) and source from config/rules.json.

modules.label: Care records & reviews
modules.summary: Support plans, individual risk assessments, local authority care reviews, support and funding packages and DoLS authorisations kept in date at each home (Yasmin, 19 Nov), rated by the tested rules engine.
modules.tracker: Care records tracker (per home; the live build reads review dates per resident)
modules.basis_note: Care Act 2014 reviews and DoLS authorisations are legal duties; support plan and risk assessment review frequencies are Esto Care policy. Each item shows its own basis and source from config/rules.json.

modules.label: Infection control
modules.summary: Quarterly infection prevention and control audit. Softer alerts: a reminder 2 weeks and 1 week before, and the first alert only at 7 days late.
modules.tracker: Infection Control Audit (Word form today; Hamida converting to Excel)
modules.basis_note: Legal requirement: Health and Social Care Act 2008 Code of Practice on the prevention and control of infections (regulated services). Quarterly frequency is internal policy.

modules.label: Maintenance
modules.summary: One maintenance tracker per home. Managers update it every Friday instead of emailing it round; repairs past their target show in the Monday report.
modules.tracker: Maintenance tracker (one per home; no copies)
modules.basis_note: Internal policy. Supports CQC Reg 15 (premises) and the landlord's repair duties. Zara reviews it with managers every two weeks.

modules.label: Occupancy
modules.summary: The finance team's occupancy tracker is the master. Managers confirm it is up to date every Monday and Friday; onboarding documents for new residents are flagged when late. Head office only.
modules.tracker: Esto Care Occupancy Tracker (finance master copy)
modules.basis_note: Internal policy. Initials or references only, never full names (UK GDPR data minimisation).

modules.label: QA audit actions
modules.summary: Hamida's monthly QA visit. The app tracks the actions only: owner, target date and a progress update at the 2-week mid-point.
modules.tracker: QA Audit (monthly visit report and action plan)
modules.basis_note: Internal policy. Supports CQC Reg 17 (good governance: audit and improve).

modules.label: Spot checks & visits
modules.summary: Monthly unannounced day or night visit by the manager: done or not done.

questions: Unannounced visit carried out and form uploaded

modules.label: Manager monthly report
modules.summary: The service manager's monthly report: submitted or not.

modules.label: Supervision & training
modules.summary: Each staff member's supervision and mandatory training due and expiry dates. Waiting for Hamida's trackers.
modules.tracker: Supervision and training trackers (Hamida, in progress)
modules.basis_note: Legal requirement: CQC Reg 18 (staffing: support, training, supervision) and the Health and Care Act 2022 (Oliver McGowan training). Frequencies are internal policy.
